items: Mazbooti aur lachak ki wajah se nylon kapron (jurabein, varzish aur tairaki ke kapre), carpets (qaleenon) aur rassiyon mein use hota hai. Is ka kapra raincoats (barsatiyon), sportswear aur lingerie (andar pehnne ke kapron) mein use hota hai.

Mazbooti, kam friction aur garmi bardasht karne ki wajah se automotive industry (gaariyan banane ki industry) ke purze (parts), jaise gears, bearings, bushings, engine covers aur fuel lines, nylon se bante hain.
Machine ke purze, jaise screws, nuts, bolts aur doosre industrial purze, jahan mazbooti aur ghisaav ki bardasht chahiye, nylon se bante hain.
Tensile strength (khinchne ki taqat) zyada hone aur paani mein na ghisne ki wajah se rassiyan, machhli pakarne ke jaal aur dorian nylon se banti hain.
Consumer goods (rozmarra ki cheezein), jaise zips, toothbrush, hairbrush aur molded (saanche mein dhale) plastic purze, nylon se bante hain.

blocks.prompt: Machhli pakarne ke jaal nylon se kyun banaye jate hain?
blocks.explanation: Nylon ki tensile strength zyada hai aur yeh paani mein ghisaav bardasht karta hai.

items: Nylon ke istemal: kapre, qaleen, rassiyan, gears aur bearings, screws aur bolts, machhli ke jaal, zips aur brushes.
